- **rule** `templates/keep-discovery-metadata-out-variant-build`: Keep discovery metadata out of the variant's build contract; resolve facets and search through the shared taxonomy, `templateMeta.ts`, and `search.ts`. - **rule** `templates/offer-generic-broadcast-fields-image-files`: Offer `textfield`, `textarea`, `number`, and `filelist` as generic broadcast fields, with image files under `assetfolder: './images/'`.
